title: Anthropic Q3 revenue slows ahead of planned November IPO
dek: The AI start-up reported $16.8 billion in Q3 revenue, up 45% but well below prior quarter growth, and investors are tempering valuation hopes.
body:
Anthropic reported $16.8 billion in third-quarter revenue, a 45 percent increase year‑over‑year, marking a substantial deceleration from the previous quarter’s 140 percent surge. The company is moving toward a planned November initial public offering (IPO) , a public stock offering , and some investors now expect its market valuation to fall below $1.5 trillion.

## Why it matters

Anthropic’s results are a high-profile early test of how investors price generative-AI companies in public markets. The slowdown from a 140 percent jump in Q2 to 45 percent growth in Q3 signals that the blistering expansion seen earlier this year may be moderating. That change, combined with a difficult market for tech listings, is cooling expectations for one of the AI boom’s most closely watched Wall Street debuts.

## The details

- Q3 revenue: $16.8 billion.
- Q3 growth rate: 45 percent (year‑over‑year).
- Q2 growth rate: 140 percent (year‑over‑year).
- IPO status: Planned for November.
- Investor sentiment: Some now expect valuation below $1.5 trillion.

Unavailable or not yet disclosed: exact IPO pricing, target share count, lead underwriters, the company’s guidance for future quarters, and any updated forecasts from Anthropic’s management ahead of the offering.

## What to watch

Watch how Anthropic frames near‑term guidance and growth drivers in its IPO documents; those disclosures will shape investor appetite. Also monitor public-market reaction in November — whether demand supports the adjusted valuation expectations or prompts further repricing.
